Description
Founded in 1896 by Dame Frances Dove, the original school in Buckinghamshire, UK, set a new standard for academic rigour and character development. Today, Wycombe Abbey International School Bangkok continues that vision, ensuring that the same spirit of excellence thrives in the heart of Southeast Asia. Wycombe Abbey is a globally respected name with a heritage rooted in exceptional academic results and character education. Wycombe Abbey has been at the forefront of academic achievement, with 28% of graduates annually securing places at Oxford and Cambridge during the last 10 years.
